name: Touma Ninden Haruna to Maya ~Inshokuchuu ni, Kunoichi Otsu~
original_name: 闘魔忍伝 ハルナとマヤ ～淫触蟲に、くノ一堕つ～
source:
Two kunoichi sisters headed off into enemy territory to asses the strength of the enemy troops.
However, they were ambushed by the enemy shortly after infiltrating their lands.
The sisters had been through countless battles before, but the enemy shinobi were simply too many, and they were captured before they could fight their way out.
Their enemy was not dumb, they realized that they could use both the sisters' strength, and the information they held. And thus the interrogation began.
And thus, the trampling of the two kunoichi began...

The actions were numerous and neverending. Assault, violation, gangbang, inter-species violation...
Will there be an end to the sisters' torment...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038999.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
春奈與摩耶是一對女忍姊妹，為了評估敵軍戰力，她們潛入了敵方領地。

然而，才剛剛完成潛入，她們便中了敵人的埋伏。姊妹倆早已身經百戰，可敵方忍者人數實在太多；還沒來得及殺出重圍，她們就雙雙遭到俘虜。

敵人並不愚蠢，很快便意識到，無論姊妹二人的力量還是她們掌握的情報，都有利用價值。審訊就此開始。
對兩名女忍的蹂躪，也隨之拉開序幕……

襲擊、強姦、輪姦、異種凌辱……手段層出不窮，彷彿永遠沒有盡頭。
姊妹倆的折磨究竟何時才會結束……？
